scope_note: Covers this repository's own real published capabilities (capabilities/*/*/*/contract.json). traverse-framework/traverse#899's own inventory (contracts/governance/ecca-capability-inventory.json in that repo) covers a different, unrelated set of artifacts under that repo's contracts/examples/ and contracts/inference/ trees -- despite some capability_id values coincidentally matching, they are not the same content and #899 does not satisfy Spec 534 FR-020 for this repository's catalog. Regenerated 2026-08-10 for registry#253 so every published capability ID is classified; CI now fails if inventory coverage drifts.

Status transitions are domain facts independent consumers may observe. Governed event product core.action-item.status-transitioned@1.0.0 remains published (immutable publishers list still cites capability 1.1.0; CI does not require rewriting publishers for later emitter versions). Capability contract 1.3.0 declares emits=[{event_id: core.action-item.status-transitioned, version: 1.0.0}], service_type=subscribable, requires action_item_id, and the WASM guest actually calls traverse_host::emit_event on accepted transitions (reason_code=ok) with payload {action_item_id, from_status, to_status, actor_id} — real emit, not declaration-only. Immutable prior versions: 1.0.0/1.1.0 empty emits[]; 1.2.0 declaration-only honesty.
